about_the_game:
The Stuck in the Present Mixtape is both a personal collection of songs and a cinematic soundtrack to the game. With tracks in Filipino and English, it echoes the haunting voices and fading memories of two lives lost beneath the city while expanding into the greater soundscape of the living subway. Blending ambience, lyrics, and layered textures, the music moves between personal emotion and cinematic scope. English translations are included for select tracks.

Features:

  • 6 original tracks produced in-house by Dusk Wave Arts

  • Songs performed in both Filipino (English translations included for select lyrics) and English

  • A blend of personal storytelling and cinematic atmosphere

  • Available in Mp3 format

  • An emotional soundtrack that carries the world of the game beyond the screen
